verdict.rationale: Fin exposes a documented Agent API (Discover capabilities, Ask Fin, Run a procedure, Escalate) plus a published, actively maintained Node SDK and webhooks for event-driven automation, and the REST API is confirmed live/auth-gated at runtime — all enabling headless, programmatic/CI-driven invocation without the UI. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline examples/docs, and some orchestration endpoints are still gated behind a 'Preview API' version rather than fully GA.
